acv.quote: Two hundred and fifty K ACV.

header.reason: Halima, the COO, picked the competitor because it showed the actual people who would answer on an on-sale morning. Jordan points to our better platform, but that is not what decided it.

findings.label: What started it
findings.finding: Lead with what happens when payments fail mid on-sale.
findings.why: Payments failed four minutes into a big on-sale, and the old provider only replied after it ended.
findings.quote: payments started failing about four minutes in

findings.label: Who decided
findings.finding: Tell Halima who answers when things break, not how fast we run.
findings.why: Halima decided alone in one meeting. Ben showed her our load test results and she only said 'good'.
findings.quote: it was Halima's call and she made it in one meeting

findings.label: The competitor
findings.finding: Answer 'who's my person' with real names and on-call people.

line.text: Enterprise support: a technical account manager embedded in your team, with a 15-minute response for critical issues

findings.why: Per Ben, the competitor brought its actual account team. Jordan's view that they over-promised is his own unchecked guess.
findings.quote: someone on call for every major on-sale

findings.label: Our message
findings.finding: Stop answering 'who's my person' with support tiers and response times.

line.text: Enterprise support: a technical account manager embedded in your team, with a 15-minute response for critical issues

findings.why: Jordan walked Halima through our support plans, and her reply marked the moment the deal was lost.
findings.quote: so it's a queue with a faster timer.

findings.label: Missing proof
findings.finding: Add a ticketing customer story about who picked up mid on-sale.
findings.why: Halima wanted to see what we do at minute four. Jordan had ticketing logos but no customer to vouch.
findings.quote: I had logos. I didn't have a person.

findings.label: Their words
findings.finding: Say 'a name, not a queue' instead of 'support'.

line.text: All Stripe customers receive 24x7 phone, email, and chat help

findings.why: Nobody at Tixhaven said 'support'. They asked 'who' and talked about 'on-sale morning'.
